table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Type = ' Sales',
	documentcode = 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SaleInvCode, 10))), 
	SalesMan = (SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = S.SManCode),
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	CustomerName = A.Name,
	SMANCode=S.SManCode,
	InvCode=S.SaleInvCode, 
	Date = S.Date,
	SaleValue = S.InvTotal
FROM
	SaleLedger S, Accounts A
WHERE
	S.SManCode IN (:ai_smancode) AND
	S.Posted = 'Y' AND
	S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND 
	S.CustCode = A.AccCode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	Type = ' Sales Return',
	documentcode = 'SR-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SRInvCode, 10))), 
	SalesMan = (SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = S.SManCode),
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	CustomerName = A.Name,
	SMANCode=S.SManCode,
	InvCode=S.SRInvCode,
	Date = S.Date,
	SaleValue = - S.InvTotal
FROM
	SRLedger S, Accounts A
WHERE
	S.SManCode IN (:ai_smancode) AND
	S.Posted = 'Y' AND
	S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND 
	S.CustCode = A.AccCode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	Type = 'Credit Note',
	documentcode = VC.ShortName + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(H.GLVochCode, 10))), 
	SalesMan = (SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = H.SManCode),
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	CustomerName = A.Name,
	SMANCode=H.SManCode,
	InvCode=H.GLVochCode,
	Date = H.Date,
	SaleValue = - D.Credit
FROM
	GLHeader H, GLDetail D, Accounts A, VocherCategory VC
WHERE
	H.VochCatCode IN (20,22) AND 
	H.SManCode IN (:ai_smancode) AND
	H.Posted = 'Y' AND
	H.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND 
	H.VochCatCode = VC.VochCatCode AND
	H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND
	D.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
	D.Credit > 0
table.sort: salesman A, type A, date A, invcode A
